mapIdentity.scope: Hong Kong government heritage map feature 896 binds both the square uphill end and long descending flue. Original 5 m elevation samples register both parts of the structure on the slope.

note: Tapered square brick chimney with offset plinth and oversailing upper coping. The measured survey height is 19.304 m; the flue follows the official narrow boundary toward the pumping station.
